data.one_liner: Widgets that partially overlap each other for a compact layout.
data.what_it_does: Intelligently stacks widgets allowing them to partially overlap for a compact layout. Provides responsive sizing, horizontal and vertical axes, RTL support, and an overflow counter.
use_when: You need to display a compact list of avatars or participants.
You want elements to partially overlap in limited screen space.
avoid_when: You need a standard non-overlapping row or column layout.
strengths: Pure RenderBox architecture for high performance.
Supports both explicit lists and on-demand builders with overflow counters.
data.minimal_example:
OverlapStack(
  minSpacing: 0.5,
  maxSpacing: 0.8,
  itemSize: const Size(40, 40),
  children: const [
    CircleAvatar(child: Text('A')),
    CircleAvatar(child: Text('B')),
    CircleAvatar(child: Text('C')),
  ],
)
